_comment: Who owns each board channel. This is the ONE place ownership is declared;
brief.py and board.py both read it, so changing a value here changes what
claude-code       this CLI writes the code itself
codex             this CLI writes the packet, Codex writes the code
other-developer   out of scope: read-only, lanes frozen, no file edits
To take the PWA channel, change pwa to "claude-code" (or "codex") and say
so in the session. Set it back to "other-developer" when handing it back.
Product Owner ruling 2026-07-26: web = claude-code, admin = codex,
